Model Train Sold Prices — Complete List

Every verified sold listing behind the Dragginmasters Trains price guide: real eBay sold prices for N scale and HO scale model train locomotives, each one checked against the actual sold listing. 2749 comps below, updated 2026-11-20. Prices shown are the final sold prices; control types (DC, DCC-ready, DCC, DCC with sound) are kept on separate lines because a decoder changes what a locomotive is worth.
